subject.title: fix(anthropic): wire buildModelFetch into the github-copilot createClient branch

question: Should GitHub Copilot Anthropic traffic switch to OpenClaw's guarded host fetch now, accepting that custom/private base URLs may fail closed under the SSRF and timeout policy?
rationale: The code change is the right owner-boundary hardening, but it intentionally changes transport behavior for an existing provider path and the current proof does not exercise a real network path.

options.title: Require proof, then accept guard
